# SupportOps workspace instructions

Follow root AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/ai-engineering-tutor/SKILL.md. Read current J0-J5 evidence before setup. Do not install a second coach, initialize the uploaded M/T route, reset progress or scaffold the full stack.

Explain before beginner predictions. Guide one runnable result; honor direct questions and requested worked examples. Separate Learn, Assess, Build together and explicit maintainer work. Preserve native evidence rules and record assistance without inventing mastery.

Use docs/project/RELEASES.md for bounded tasks and docs/PROGRESS_PROTOCOL.md for state. The reserved app directory is not implemented software. Skill discovery depends on the host; read the entrypoint directly if necessary rather than claim automatic activation.

No paid calls, external traces, deployment, raw customer-data publication or real commerce operations without corresponding authorization. Keep private learner evidence and secrets out of public history. Static repository checks do not establish application behavior or learning outcomes.
